description: This file contains logging functions for various FAPI protocol messages related to 5G NR radio communication, including error indications, CRC indications, DL/UL TTI requests, RACH, SRS, and PDU logging with detailed formatting.

methods.name: log_error_indication
methods.description: Logs error indication messages with details such as slot, error code, message ID, and optional expected slot.

methods.name: log_crc_indication
methods.description: Logs CRC indication messages including PDU details like RNTI, HARQ ID, TB status, SINR, RSSI, RSRP, and timing advance.

methods.name: log_dl_tti_request
methods.description: Logs downlink TTI request messages with detailed PDU information such as PDCCH, PDSCH, SSB, PRS, and CSI-RS PDUs.

methods.name: log_slot_indication
methods.description: Logs slot indication messages with time point and context.

methods.name: log_ul_tti_request
methods.description: Logs uplink TTI request messages with PDUs like PRACH, PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS.

methods.name: log_ul_dci_request
methods.description: Logs uplink DCI request messages with PDCCH PDUs.

methods.name: log_rach_indication
methods.description: Logs RACH indication messages including preamble details, timing, and power.

methods.name: log_rx_data_indication
methods.description: Logs reception data indication messages with RNTI, HARQ ID, and TBS.

methods.name: log_tx_data_request
methods.description: Logs transmission data requests with slot and number of PDUs.

methods.name: log_uci_indication
methods.description: Logs UCI indication messages including PUCCH and PUSCH PDUs with detailed formats.

methods.name: log_srs_indication
methods.description: Logs SRS indication messages with RNTI, ports, symbols, and positioning info.
